value.description: The target's normal result (`null`, scalar, array or object), unchanged apart from the MCP transforms.

method.description: The operation's `localId`; the target is `<installed slug>.<method>`.

params.description:
Params for the target, validated against the target's author params schema. The reserved `dryRun`

Action.description: A stored automation (§6.1). `revision` and `origin` are server-assigned and read-only on the wire.

alwaysRun.description: Runs even when its queue is paused.

concurrent.description: Start all top-level nodes at once (Streamer.bot "Concurrent").

group.description: Folder path such as `Alerts/Twitch`; organisation only.

name.description: Unique per installation among non-draft actions, case-insensitively. Actions run by ID or name.

origin.description: Where the action came from (D-029 trust, D-030 drafts). Server-assigned, read-only; ignored on input.

queue.description: The queue this action runs on; the nil UUID is the Default queue.

revision.description: Server-assigned, +1 on every write; approvals bind to it (§8.8). Read-only.

tags.description: Tags; also used by scopes such as `actions:run:<tag>`.

ActionId.description: Identifies an action. New IDs are UUIDv7; imported Streamer.bot GUIDs (v4) are kept.

ActionRef.description:
How a [`Node::RunAction`] names its target (§6.4, §8.8 rule 2). A `template` target is unresolvable at
check time and counts as tier 4.

oneOf.description: Resolved at run time from a template.

template.description: Renders to an action ID or name.

ActionRevisionRef.description: An action pinned to a revision (§8.1, §8.8). An object, never a tuple (§3).

ApprovalBinding.description: An approval bound to one call (§8.8 rule 4).

argsHash.description: Binding hash of the call's own params, minus `dryRun` and `approvalId`.

expiresAt.description: When the approval stops permitting a call to **start** (one-shot) or descendants to execute (session grant).

plan.description: For composite calls: what was approved.

sessionGrant.description: A session grant ("approve for 15 min") exempts argument hashes but still pins revisions and the call multiset.

ApprovedPlan.description:
What an approval of a composite call covers (§8.8 rule 4). Computed by the server, never from
client-supplied data.

actions.description: Every action the plan reaches (root, inline and queued `RunAction` targets), pinned.

calls.description: Every tier-3 node occurrence the plan would execute; a repeated node or operation is a separate entry.

ArgWrites.description: Which run args an operation can write (§8.1, §8.8). Tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: Writes no args (its result may still be stored through `saveAs`).
Writes the one arg whose name is the literal value at `nameParam` (*Set argument*).

nameParam.description: Params path (as in `fieldErrors.path`) holding the arg name.

AuthContext.description: The authorization context of a call or run (§8.8).

chain.description: Set once the context has crossed a `causedBy` edge (rule 5).

lineage.description: Runs this context has passed through (nested `RunAction`, `causedBy` chains), newest last.

maxTier.description: The highest tier this context may ever execute.

principal.description: Who started the entry call or run.

surface.description: The surface the context was created at.

Badge.description: A platform badge shown next to a user (§5.3).

id.description: The badge set ID on the platform (`subscriber`, `moderator`).

title.description: Human-readable title, when known (untrusted on third-party platforms).

version.description: The badge version within the set (`12` for a 12-month subscriber badge), when the platform has one.

BatchExecuteParams.description: Params of `batch.execute` (§8.2): ordered execution of up to 64 requests.

haltOnFailure.description: Stop at the first failing entry.

requests.description: The requests, executed in order under the caller's context.

BatchExecuteResult.description: Result of `batch.execute` (§8.2): one response per entry, in order. Entries after a halt are absent.

children.description: Nodes run when this case matches.

value.description: The literal to compare the switch value with (after `autoType` coercion when enabled).

ChainOrigin.description: Where a derived context's restrictions come from (§8.8 rule 5).

originPrincipal.description: That run's principal; tier policy (MCP exclusion, draft-first) is keyed on it.

originRun.description: The run started at the entry surface; its restrictions are the ones inherited.

ChatText.description: Chat text with its parsed fragments (§5.3). `text` is the plain-text rendering and is untrusted.

fragments.description: The message split into typed fragments, in order. Concatenating their `text` gives `text`.

oneOf.description: Source stored as a script file managed by the app.

path.description: Path of the script, relative to the scripts directory.

CompareOp.description: Comparison operators of [`Condition`] (§6.4), the Streamer.bot set.

oneOf.description: Left matches the regular expression on the right; captures land in `match`.
The left path does not exist in the run context.
The left value is null or an empty string.

Condition.description: A comparison between two rendered templates (§6.4).

autoType.description: Compare after coercing both sides to the same type (number, boolean, string).

ConnectionId.description: Identifies a connection (an account or app link of a connector).

Contributes.description:
What a plugin contributes (§11). Kinds other than events and operations are carried as opaque JSON
until spec 12 fixes their schemas.

events.description: Event types (also trigger types, §6.2). Each becomes `<slug>.<id>`.

operations.description: Operations (sub-actions, methods and MCP tools in one, §8.1). Each becomes `<slug>.<id>`.

ContributionRef.description:
A persisted reference to a contribution (an event type, trigger type or operation), §4 and §5.3.
Flattened into [`crate::Trigger`] and [`crate::Node::Op`]. `plugin` is **required** when the slug of
`type` is not reserved for core and **forbidden** when it is; codegen adds the matching
`if/then/else` clause to every schema that embeds this type, and [`ContributionRef::validate`]
enforces the same rule in code.

plugin.description: The contributing plugin's ID. Required for a non-core slug, forbidden for a core slug.

Deprecation.description: Deprecation notice (§7.4). Deprecated items stay for at least two minor releases and six months.

draftOf.description: The live entity the draft proposes to change, when it targets an existing one.

id.description: The draft's ID (an `ai_draft` action ID or a pending-change ID).

DraftResult.description:
Result of a tier-2 configuration call that was deferred into a draft under an MCP context (§6.1):
nothing live changed; `plan` says what *Apply* will execute.

DryRunResult.description: Result of a call with `dryRun: true` (§8.1): what the call would do, with nothing executed.

actions.description: For a composite call: every action the run can reach, pinned to its revision (§8.8 rule 4).

diff.description: For configuration operations: the proposed change as a diff, when the operation can compute one.

dryRun.description: Always `true`; discriminates this shape from a normal result.

plan.description: Every operation the call would execute, repeats included.

wouldRequireApproval.description: Whether the real call would need in-app approval under the calling context.

EntityId.description: Identifies any persisted entity when the kind is carried separately (drafts, pending changes).

ErrorCode.description: Application error code (§8.5): an open string enum. New codes are additive.

code.description: The stable application error code. Clients treat unknown codes as a generic failure.

docsUrl.description: Link to documentation about this error.

Event.description:
One occurrence from a source. Immutable once emitted. `payload` is an opaque object on the wire;
the catalog maps each `type` to its payload schema and the generated helpers parse on demand (§5.2).

id.description: UUIDv7, monotonic per process; the replay cursor (§8.4).

payload.description: The typed payload, an object whose schema the catalog publishes under `events.<type>.payload`.

platform.description: The platform (open enum): `twitch`, `youtube`, `kick`, `x`, `bluesky`, or a plugin slug.

ts.description: When it happened upstream, or the emission time if unknown.

EventContribution.description: An event type a plugin contributes (§11). Becomes event type `<slug>.<id>`.

filters.description: Payload fields a trigger can filter on.

highVolume.description: Delivered only when a session lists the type in `highVolume` (§8.4).

payload.description: Payload schema (JSON Schema 2020-12, object root). Shared types are referenced as `den://schemas/v0/<Name>.json`.

payloadVersion.description: Payload schema version, starting at 1. A breaking change bumps it and the plugin's major version (§5.2).

testPayload.description: Path of a JSON fixture inside the package used by "Test trigger" and the simulator.

EventDef.description: A known event type (§5.2): its payload schema, trigger filters and flags.

critical.description: Never dropped by the slow-consumer policy (§8.4).

examples.description: At least one example payload; the first is also the "Test trigger" fixture.

filters.description: Payload fields a trigger can filter on (§6.2).

highVolume.description: Delivered only when a session lists the type in `highVolume` (§8.4).

payload.description:
Payload schema (JSON Schema 2020-12). The root MUST be `type: object`, and no top-level property may
use a reserved run-context root name (§6.3).

payloadVersion.description: Current payload schema version, starting at 1 (§5.2).

EventId.description: Identifies one event occurrence. Always UUIDv7, monotonic per process, used as a replay cursor (§8.4).

causedBy.description:
The run that caused this event, including the synthetic run of a direct operation call. Server-assigned,
never settable by clients, connectors or plugins (§8.8 rule 5, §16).

correlationId.description: Upstream message ID, for de-duplication and moderation links.

payloadVersion.description: Schema version of this event type's payload, starting at 1 (§5.2). States the shape actually delivered.

replay.description: Re-delivered from the replay buffer or from history (§8.4).

test.description: Emitted by the simulator or "Test trigger".

EventsDroppedNotification.description: Params of the `events.dropped` notification (§8.4): the slow-consumer policy dropped events.

since.description: The last event delivered before the drop; use it as a replay cursor.

EventsSubscribeParams.description: Params of `events.subscribe` (§8.4): adds to the session's subscription set.

highVolume.description: High-volume event types to add, listed exactly.

since.description: Replay cursor: re-deliver events newer than this ID.

EventsUnsubscribeParams.description: Params of `events.unsubscribe` (§8.4): removes from the session's subscription set.

Exposure.description: Which surfaces expose an operation (§8.1). MCP exposure is further filtered by tier (§9.6).

mcp.description: Offered as an MCP tool (only when `tier ≤ 3`, §9.6).

path.description: JSON Pointer-style path of the offending field (`/message`, `/source/name`).

Filter.description: A trigger filter on a payload field (§6.2).

value.description: The operand, validated against the field's schema; `between` takes `[min, max]`.

FilterOp.description: Filter operators (§6.2). A closed union: adding a value is a breaking change (§7.2).

oneOf.description: Not a member of the list in `value`.
The field is present (`value` is `true`) or absent (`false`).

FilterableField.description: A payload field a trigger can filter on (§6.2).

optionsFrom.description: An operation name whose result feeds the value picker, when the field has known values.

specificity.description: Rank used by spec 03's "specific beats any" precedence; higher is more specific.

Fragment.description:
One fragment of a chat message, tagged by `kind` (§5.3). The union is extensible: a client renders
an unknown fragment as its `text` (§7.2).

provider.description: The emote provider (`twitch`, `7tv`, `bttv`…), when not the platform itself.

login.description: The mentioned user's login, when resolved (untrusted).

text.description: The mention as typed, including any `@` (untrusted).

userId.description: The mentioned user's platform ID, when resolved.

tier.description: The cheermote tier the amount falls into.

Hello.description: The `hello` notification the server sends on connect (§8.3).

heartbeatMs.description: Heartbeat interval; the server closes a session silent for three intervals.

HistoryPolicy.description: Whether runs of an action are recorded in history (§6.1).

pending.description: Also show runs while they are pending in a queue.

height.description: Intrinsic height in pixels, when known.

scale.description: Device pixel ratio the image is meant for (1, 2, 3…), when known.

width.description: Intrinsic width in pixels, when known.

L10nString.description:
A user-facing string. In plugin manifests it may hold `%key%` placeholders resolved from the plugin's
localisation files (§11); these are never templates.

Money.description: An amount of money or a platform unit (§3). Floats are never used for money.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code (`USD`) or a platform unit such as `bits`.

exponent.description: Number of decimal places between minor and major units (2 for USD, 0 for bits).

Node.description:
The node kinds of the sub-action tree (§6.4). Extensible with a fallback: a client renders an unknown
`kind` as a read-only placeholder (§7.2).

Parameters, validated against the operation's authoring schema at save time and its invocation
schema after rendering (§10.1).

plugin.description: The contributing plugin's ID. Required for a non-core slug, forbidden for a core slug.

saveAs.description: Store the operation's result under this run-argument name.

color.description: Display colour, as a CSS colour string.

random.description: Run one weighted-random child instead of all.

then.description: Nodes run when the condition holds.

oneOf.description: Multi-way branch on a rendered value.

autoType.description: Compare after coercing both sides to the same type.

default.description: Nodes run when no case matched.

condition.description: The condition, evaluated before every iteration.

oneOf.description: Skip to the next iteration of the innermost loop.

args.description: Arguments passed to the child; templates rendered in the parent's context.

oneOf.description: An unknown imported node type; never runs; kept verbatim (WS-15 rule).

origin.description: The importer that produced it, e.g. `streamerbot`, and the original type name.

NodeId.description: Identifies a sub-action node in the tree (§6.4).

OperationContribution.description:
An operation a plugin contributes (§11). Becomes method `<slug>.<id>`. A declared tier lower than the
host's classification of the permissions it uses is raised.

external.description: Talks to an external platform or app.

idempotent.description: Repeating the call has no further effect.

params.description: Author params schema (object root). Leaf fields may carry `x-den-template` (§10.1).

result.description: Result schema. Object root for tier ≥ 1.

sentence.description: Sentence shown in the sub-action list, with `{param}` placeholders: `Send {message} to Acme chat`.

tier.description: Declared risk tier (§8.1); the host may raise it.

OperationDef.description: One operation (§8.1), exposed on up to three surfaces from this one definition.

description.description: Description. For MCP the first line holds category and search keywords (§9.6).

examples.description:
At least one example; CI validates every example against the schemas. Tier ≥ 1 operations need a
normal and a dry-run example, tier-2 configuration operations also a draft example (§8.1).

external.description: Talks to an external platform or app (MCP `openWorldHint`).

highVolumeResult.description: The result is large or frequent; clients should not log it by default.

idempotent.description: Repeating the call has no further effect (MCP `idempotentHint`).

Author params schema (JSON Schema 2020-12). The root MUST be `type: object` (§9.6). Codegen adds the
reserved `dryRun` and `approvalId` params and derives `paramsAuthoring` from it (§10.1).

platforms.description: OS gate: `["windows"]` for Windows-only apps; hidden elsewhere with a reason (§14).

result.description: Normal result schema. The root MUST be `type: object` for tier ≥ 1; tier 0 may use any root (§8.1).

timeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds; absent means the engine default.

writesArgs.description: Which run args the operation can write, for the binding hash (§8.8).

OperationExample.description:
An operation example (§8.1). Examples are tests: CI validates `params` against the params schema and
`result` against the schema `shape` selects.

params.description: The params sent. For a dry-run example they include `dryRun: true`.

shape.description: Which of the three result shapes `result` is.

Origin.description: Where a document came from (§6.1). Carries the D-029 trust decision and the D-030 draft state.

oneOf.description: Created or applied by the user in the app.
Imported from another tool; runs sandboxed until the user trusts it.

trusted.description: Set by *Trust this action* after the consent screen.

oneOf.description: Proposed by an AI client over MCP; saved disabled until the user applies it.

draftOf.description: The live action this draft proposes to replace, for `actions.update` drafts.

oneOf.description: Created from a template a plugin ships.

Os.description: Operating systems an operation can be gated to (§8.1, §14).

oneOf.description: Refuse new runs while the queue is full.
Drop the oldest pending run to make room.

PendingChange.description:
A deferred configuration write created by a tier-2 operation under an MCP context (§6.1). *Apply*
replays `operation` with `params` under the user's context; *Discard* deletes it.

draftOf.description: The live entity the change targets, when it targets an existing one.

kind.description: The kind of entity the change targets: `action`, `queue`, `command`, `overlay`, `settings`.

PlanStep.description: One step of a dry-run plan (§8.1).

action.description: The stored action this step belongs to, for composite calls.

argsHash.description: The binding hash (§8.8), on tier ≥ 3 steps.

dynamicFields.description: Params paths that take run-produced values (§8.8 rule 4), on tier ≥ 3 steps.

node.description: The node this step belongs to, for composite calls.

params.description: Its params, rendered, with secrets redacted to `"***"`.

target.description: A short description of the target (a scene name, a channel), when the operation has one.

PlannedCall.description:
One planned tier-3 call (§8.8 rule 4). Exactly one identity form is set: a node in a stored action
(`action` and `node`), or a host call a plugin's dry run declared (`plugin`).

action.description: The stored action, for a node call.

argsHash.description: The binding hash of the call's params after the binding render.

dynamicFields.description:
Params paths (as in `fieldErrors.path`) whose binding render references any sentinel; part of the plan
identity and shown to the approver.

node.description: The node, for a node call.

plugin.description: The plugin, for a declared host call.

$schema.description: URL of the schema this manifest follows; the app always validates against its bundled copy.

connection.description: Connection definition (B2); fixed in spec 12. Carried as opaque JSON in v0.

definitions.description: Local JSON Schema definitions, referenced as `#/definitions/<Name>`.

icon.description: Path of a monochrome SVG icon inside the package.

l10n.description: Localisation configuration for `%key%` placeholders; fixed in spec 12. Carried as opaque JSON in v0.

manifestVersion.description: Always `0` for this schema. v0 is pre-stable.

permissions.description: Permissions (B2); fixed in spec 12. Carried as opaque JSON in v0.

settings.description: Plugin-wide settings: a JSON Schema with `x-ui` hints and `x-secret` (B2.4). Always literal (§10.1).

slug.description: Short slug: the prefix of every contribution (§4). Must not be a reserved slug.

Principal.description:
Who a context acts for (§8.8), tagged by `kind`. No variant may have a field named `kind`, which is
why the token variant carries `tokenKind` (§17.1).

oneOf.description: An API, UI or overlay token. `maxTier` is the token's limit, default 4.

tokenKind.description: What kind of client the token was issued to.

tokenId.description: The token the MCP client authenticated with.

oneOf.description: A plugin making a host call. `maxTier` comes from its permissions (spec 12).
An event-started run. `maxTier` is 4 unless derived from a causing run (rule 5).

blocking.description: FIFO, one run at a time.

id.description: The queue ID; the nil UUID is the Default queue.

maxPending.description: Maximum pending runs; absent means the engine default (spec 03).

QueueId.description: Identifies a queue. The nil UUID is the Default queue (§4).

RequestId.description: JSON-RPC request ID: a string or an integer.

oneOf.description: The normal result: the effect happened.

RiskTier.description: Risk tier (Spec 02 §8.1): 0 read, 1 reversible write, 2 configuration change, 3 external or irreversible, 4 dangerous.

code.description:
The JSON-RPC code: a protocol fault code, or `-32000` for application errors (`-32602` for
`INVALID_PARAMS`).

data.description: Structured detail, always present for application errors.

RpcNotification.description: A JSON-RPC notification (§8.2): a request without `id`, in either direction.

RpcRequest.description: A JSON-RPC request (§8.2). `params` is always an object, never positional.

id.description: The request ID, echoed in the response.

method.description: The method: a protocol method (§12) or an operation name (§8.1).

RpcResponse.description: A JSON-RPC response (§8.2). Exactly one of `result` and `error` is set.

id.description:
The request ID, or `null` when the request could not be parsed. One of the few places where `null`
is a valid value (§3).

RunId.description: Identifies one run of an action, including the synthetic run of a direct operation call (§8.8 rule 1).

oneOf.description: In the same run: shares args, waits for completion.
Enqueued on the target's queue with its own args scope.

Runtime.description: How a plugin runs (§11), tagged by `kind`. `wasm` is reserved and rejected in v0.

oneOf.description: No code: HTTP/WS requests described in the manifest.
JavaScript in the host's extension process.

entry.description: Entry module, relative to the package root.

oneOf.description: A separate process speaking JSON-RPC over stdio (§8.6).

command.description: Executable per OS (`windows`, `macos`, `linux`), relative to the package root.

entry.description: The script entry point, when `interpreter` is set.

interpreter.description: An interpreter requirement such as `python>=3.12`, when the sidecar is a script.

requirements.description: A lock file of the script's dependencies, when `interpreter` is set.

highVolume.description: High-volume event types to deliver, listed exactly (§8.4).

since.description: Replay cursor: re-deliver events newer than this ID (§8.4).

token.description: An API token (`sdt_…`). Absent only when pairing (spec 06).

gap.description: `true` when `since` was older than the replay buffer and the client should resync.

replayed.description: How many events were replayed for `since`.

serverTime.description: The server's clock, for skew detection.

SessionReidentifyParams.description: Params of `session.reidentify` (§8.3): replaces the session's subscription set without reconnecting.

account.description: The account on that connection (a broadcaster or bot account), when relevant.

connection.description: The connection the event arrived on, when the source has connections.

plugin.description: `core.<connector>` for built-in sources (`core.twitch`) or the plugin ID for plugin sources.

StoredDocument.description:
The persisted-document envelope (§7.3): every stored document is wrapped as
`{ "kind": "action", "schemaVersion": N, "data": {…} }`.

schemaVersion.description: The stored shape's version; migrations chain from N to N+1 on load.

SubAction.description: A node of the sub-action tree with its common fields; the node itself is flattened by `kind` (§6.4).

params.description:
Parameters, validated against the operation's authoring schema at save time and its invocation
schema after rendering (§10.1).

plugin.description: The contributing plugin's ID. Required for a non-core slug, forbidden for a core slug.

saveAs.description: Store the operation's result under this run-argument name.

color.description: Display colour, as a CSS colour string.

random.description: Run one weighted-random child instead of all.

then.description: Nodes run when the condition holds.

oneOf.description: Multi-way branch on a rendered value.

autoType.description: Compare after coercing both sides to the same type.

default.description: Nodes run when no case matched.

condition.description: The condition, evaluated before every iteration.

maxIterations.description: Safety bound on iterations; absent means the engine default (spec 03).

oneOf.description: Skip to the next iteration of the innermost loop.
Run branches concurrently and join when all finish (D-028).

ms.description: Milliseconds to wait: a literal or one `{…}` form.

args.description: Arguments passed to the child; templates rendered in the parent's context.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline in milliseconds; absent means the engine default (spec 04).

oneOf.description: An unknown imported node type; never runs; kept verbatim (WS-15 rule).

origin.description: The importer that produced it, e.g. `streamerbot`, and the original type name.

enabled.description: Disabled nodes are skipped and count as tier 0 (§8.8 rule 2).

weight.description: Weight used when the parent picks one random child.

Surface.description: The surface a context was created at (§8.8).

oneOf.description: A sub-action node inside a run.
A trigger firing on an event.

Template.description:
A string in the template syntax of §10 (`{user.displayName}`, `{= count * 2}`, mixed text). Parsed
when saved; the grammar and AST live in a later card.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with milliseconds and a `Z` suffix (Spec 02 §3).

TokenId.description: Identifies an API token record. The token value itself (`sdt_…`) is a secret and never appears on the wire.

TokenKind.description: What kind of client a token was issued to (§8.8).

oneOf.description: An overlay or deck, limited to `events:read` and `variables:read` scopes (§8.7).

Trigger.description:
A trigger (§6.2): a trigger type **is** an event type. On the wire the contribution is flattened:
`{ "type": "twitch.cheer" }` or `{ "type": "acme.gift", "plugin": "io.github.alice.acmelive" }`.

alwaysRun.description: Fire even when a more specific trigger matched (Streamer.bot semantics).

config.description: Type-specific settings (command text, timer interval…), schema from the catalog. Always literal (§10.1).

plugin.description: The contributing plugin's ID. Required for a non-core slug, forbidden for a core slug.

unresolved.description: Read-only, derived: `plugin` is not installed; the trigger never fires until it is (§4).

TriggerId.description: Identifies a trigger inside an action.

UnknownEventPayload.description: Payload of a `<slug>.unknown` event (§5.2): an upstream event the connector has no type for yet.

upstreamType.description: The upstream event type as the platform names it (an EventSub subscription type, for example).

upstreamVersion.description: The upstream event version, when the platform versions its events.

UntrustedString.description:
A string that carries viewer- or third-party-controlled text (chat text, usernames, titles, plugin
output). Marked `x-den-untrusted: true` in schemas; MCP and the AI layer wrap such values (§3, §9.6)
and untrusted text never satisfies an approval (§16).

UserRef.description: A normalised reference to the actor of an event (§5.3). `login` and `displayName` are untrusted text.

badges.description: Badges the platform shows for this user.

color.description: The user's chat colour as a CSS colour string, when known.

platform.description: The platform the user belongs to (open enum).

pronouns.description: Pronouns, when the platform or a pronoun service provides them.

updatedBy.description: Who last wrote it. Server-assigned, read-only.

APPROVAL_REQUIRED.description: In-app approval pending (details.approvalId); details.reason = "binding_mismatch" with details.mismatch in { "args", "revision", "unplanned_call", "expired" } and details.action/details.node, or details.reason = "unattended" for a tier-3 node reached through a causedBy chain with nobody to answer.

CANCELLED.description: Cancelled by the client or by shutdown.

INVALID_PARAMS.description: Schema validation failed. Always sent with JSON-RPC code -32602; fieldErrors set.

INVALID_STATE.description: Wrong state (e.g. queue paused, running a disabled draft).

PAUSED.description: "Pause AI control" or a global pause is on.

PERMISSION_DENIED.description: Scope missing (details.required lists it), or the call's effective tier exceeds the context's maxTier (details.reason = "tier_exceeds_context", plus details.node inside a run and details.chain when inherited across a causedBy chain).

UNSUPPORTED_VERSION.description: Unsupported rpcVersion on REST (WS closes with 4002); details.supported gives the range.

UPSTREAM_ERROR.description: Platform or app returned an error (details.upstream).

identify_timeout.description: The client did not call session.identify within 10 s.

message_too_large.description: A message exceeded the size limit.

rate_limited.description: Rate limited, or the session kept overflowing its send queue.

server_shutting_down.description: The server is shutting down; clients should reconnect with backoff.

unsupported_rpc_version.description: Unsupported rpcVersion; the reason carries the supported range.
